what: Completed the real trip's setup, refreshed its route evidence, and found why the accommodation recommendation cannot be useful yet
authorised_by: owner: 'Me (26) Sister (19) Mom (51), not booked please recommend, explore first'
corrections_to_earlier_reporting: planning_mode was ALREADY explore_first; my earlier probe read it from trip_basics when it sits at the snapshot's top level, and wrongly reported None
accommodation_status was ALREADY not_booked, same probe error
confirmed is a SetupDraft field, not a snapshot key; reading setup['confirmed'] returned None because the key never existed

left_null_deliberately.owner_nationality and member nationality: drives entry-requirement generation for three real people; not guessed
left_null_deliberately.member tags: would be inventing two real people's tastes

hash_gate_fired_as_designed.recovery: discover_places re-run, free (openstreetmap:discover US$0.00), served from provider cache in 0.4s, status verified, 832 candidates

accommodation_recommendation.why_no_comparison: _hotel_recommendation scores candidates whose kind == 'hotel_area'. The catalogue contains exactly one, and it is synthetic — the centroid of whatever is selected. With one candidate there is no runner-up and no delta, so no neighbourhood comparison is possible at all.
accommodation_recommendation.why_the_centroid_is_meaningless_here: the four selected places are obscure peaks — Dailaokengshan, Yuantanzikengshan, Daxiangshan, Ejiaogeshan — so the recommended base is the middle of four hills

ranking_finding.summary: the ranker buries a city's landmarks under near-identical low-information features
ranking_finding.discovery_is_not_at_fault: Taipei 101, CKS Memorial Hall, National Palace Museum, Red House, Beitou Hot Spring Museum and Elephant Mountain are all present in the 832-candidate catalogue. Checked because `out center qt` truncation is a known risk.
ranking_finding.root_cause: group_preference_fit is the largest dimension at 30 of 100 and is driven by tag matching. A peak carries [nature, rewarding_walks, sightseeing] and matches three recorded preferences for 27/30; Taipei 101 carries [sightseeing] alone for 12.8/30. With 85 near-identical peaks in the catalogue they saturate the head of the ranking.
ranking_finding.is_city_icon_carries_no_weight: 302 candidates are flagged is_city_icon, but the flag appears in ranking.py only in lane assignment, `pros` and `why_shown` — never in any score computation. Landmark status contributes 0 points.
ranking_finding.what_if_tested: adding culture, markets and night_view to the profile moved the top 50 from 49 peaks to 44 peaks + 4 museums + 1 historic; the top 6 did not change. So this is not a missing-tag problem.
ranking_finding.not_fixed_deliberately: FORMULA_WEIGHTS is locked at 30/20/20/10/15/5 by decision, and 'a port that alters ranking is a regression'. This needs a decision ticket, not a unilateral edit.

gate_1_status: still open. Setup is now complete and evidence-backed, but the trip's place selection is four obscure peaks, so neither the itinerary nor the accommodation recommendation is a real Taipei trip yet.
